title: Why We Recycle
text: Every time we throw away plastic, paper, or glass, that trash can sit in a landfill for hundreds of years. Recycling gives these materials a second life instead of letting them pile up and pollute the earth. When we recycle paper, fewer trees need to be cut down to make new paper. When we recycle plastic and glass, factories use less energy than they would to make brand new materials. Small actions, like rinsing out a jar or flattening a cardboard box, make a real difference over time. The next time you have trash to throw away, think about whether it belongs in the recycling bin instead.
